Try it in five minutes

Four commands, five minutes, no account, no network after the first one. This is what a contracting authority, a notified body or a buyer can run.

1. Install

$ python -m pip install --require-hashes -r https://certanix.eu/try/requirements.txt
$ certanix-verify --version
certanix-verify 0.17.0

Every package is pinned by its SHA-256 (requirements.txt); pip refuses any other file. Then download the pack, the comparison and the key into one folder.

2. Verify a pack

$ certanix-verify verify wp2-aloha-transfer-cube-v1-act-pergroup-s0-n40-k8-release-b-v3.evidence-pack.json --key certanix-hsm.pub
VERIFIED  (0)  wp2-aloha-transfer-cube-v1-act-pergroup-s0-n40-k8-release-b-v3.evidence-pack.json
  signature valid over the canonical bytes; schema valid; no gate violation
  schema v1.14
  certanix-verify 0.17.0, rules sha256:dd64efc6d190d1cec8035997c9c95902658c250db346e4dbd743d70a4bb6993c

3. Change one byte, verify again

$ python -c "import sys;p=sys.argv[1];b=open(p,'rb').read();open(p,'wb').write(b.replace(b'0.625',b'0.925',1))" wp2-aloha-transfer-cube-v1-act-pergroup-s0-n40-k8-release-b-v3.evidence-pack.json
$ certanix-verify verify wp2-aloha-transfer-cube-v1-act-pergroup-s0-n40-k8-release-b-v3.evidence-pack.json --key certanix-hsm.pub
SIGNATURE_MISMATCH  (7)  wp2-aloha-transfer-cube-v1-act-pergroup-s0-n40-k8-release-b-v3.evidence-pack.json
  recomputed canonical bytes do not match the signed digest
  schema v1.14 (as stated by the file, not verified)
  certanix-verify 0.17.0, rules sha256:dd64efc6d190d1cec8035997c9c95902658c250db346e4dbd743d70a4bb6993c
(exit code 7)

The verifier does not know which byte changed. It knows the bytes are no longer the ones Certanix signed.

The same command on each operating system

The line above is the same in a Linux or macOS terminal and in Windows PowerShell. It replaces the first 0.625 in the file, the pack's pass rate, with 0.925.
